verdict.rationale: Ledgy documents a core cap table product: historical transactions can be imported with documents attached, reports are configurable, and the companyCaptable and companyTransactions API operations expose the data. It also documents option and share-award granting, vesting, and IFRS 2/GAAP equity reporting relevant to auditors. However, the evidence never mentions share classes, share certificates, SAFEs/convertibles, or investor-facing access to the live record. Missing for 10: explicit share class and certificate management, SAFE/convertible instrument support, investor/auditor access to the cap table as a shared source of truth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can maintain my full cap table — share classes, certificates, SAFEs, and option grants — as a live single source of truth that investors and auditors rely on

citations.quote: Bring historical transaction data into your cap table, with documents attached for maximum visibility and accuracy.
Grant share awards one by one, or in bulk, creating, signing and sharing contracts in just a few clicks.
Generate a broad suite of financial reports instantly to account for equity under IFRS 2, UK GAAP or US GAAP, with tranche-level details in one click.
The operation user can retrieve cap table data about the queried company.
